name: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
storyline:
She's chaos, the end of ends! A steel rose trapped in a cage of ice. Your best friend, Baelz Hakos from hololive English Promise!

And she was supposed to be on vacation with her friends.

What began as a relaxing trip across Australia with her friends quickly spirals into pandemonium when Bae's chaotic powers begin to run wild. Her companions are scattered across the continent, the local wildlife grows increasingly hostile, and something ancient is stirring beneath the Outback.

Now it's up to Bae to journey all across the country, rescue her friends, and restore balance before Australia descends into total chaos.
summary: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.
